title: Course Intro
description: Foundation Art Course page — all course info in one block.

description.default:
Specially designed for our little Picassos, our program focuses on refining fine motor skills, mastering pen control, and grasping fundamental art theories and concepts through creative expression.

Your child will have the opportunity to explore a plethora of mediums, including acrylic paints, watercolours, oil pastels, clay, and beyond, all while fostering confidence in their creative abilities.

Join us in nurturing the budding artist within your child!

default: There are a total of 6 terms to complete.
Following through all 6 terms is non-compulsory.
One time registration fees is applicable.
A T-shirt, Apron, & Bag will be given to new sign ups.

suppliesText.default:
Due to hygiene concerns, students are required to bring their own supplies.
Connect with us to know if the supplies you owned are compatible!
We do sell them in our studio should you need them.
